title: `_getAtomicPrices()` uses stale oracle prices without validation
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `_getAtomicPrices()` function in `ElytraDepositPoolV1` calls `oracle.getAssetPrice()` without checking if the price data is stale.
